name: spacial-shell
title: SpacialShell
description: Control the SpacialShell tiling window manager: switch workspaces, move windows, cycle layouts.
author: alice

commands.name: switch
commands.title: Switch Workspace
commands.description: List and focus workspaces on the current screen

commands.name: focus-window-left
commands.title: Focus Window Left
commands.description: Focus the window to the left

commands.name: focus-window-right
commands.title: Focus Window Right
commands.description: Focus the window to the right

commands.name: move-window-up
commands.title: Move Window Up
commands.description: Move the focused window to the workspace above

commands.name: move-window-down
commands.title: Move Window Down
commands.description: Move the focused window to the workspace below (new category)

commands.name: toggle-float
commands.title: Toggle Float
commands.description: Float or re-tile the focused window

preferences.name: spacialctl
preferences.title: spacialctl Path
preferences.description: Override the path to the spacialctl binary
